headlines.title: 上海：推进城市房地产融资协调机制“白名单”项目扩围增效
headlines.summary: 上海市人民政府办公厅印发《上海市城市更新和住房发展“十五五”规划》。其中提出，鼓励各类金融机构加强对城市更新项目的信贷支持，创新金融产品。完善住房金融相关政策。发挥城市房地产融资协调机制作用，推进城市房地产融资协调机制“白名单”项目扩围增效。深化住房公积金制度改革，拓展住房公积金覆盖面和使用范围，持续深化长三角地区住房公积金一体化合作。加大居民住房消费金融支持力度，更好满足居民合理购房信贷需求。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Expand and enhance the 'white list' projects under the urban real estate financing coordination mechanism
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Municipal People's Government General Office issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal and Housing Development in Shanghai." It proposes encouraging various financial institutions to strengthen credit support for urban renewal projects and innovate financial products. Improve housing finance-related policies. Leverage the role of the urban real estate financing coordination mechanism to advance the expansion and enhancement of "white list" projects under the urban real estate financing coordination mechanism. Deepen the reform of the housing provident fund system, expand its coverage and usage scope, and continue to deepen integrated cooperation on the housing provident fund in the Yangtze River Delta region. Increase financial support for residents' housing consumption to better meet reasonable housing loan demand.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: By end of 2026, fully launch overall renovation projects for urban villages and complete remediation and upgrading
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Municipal People's Government General Office issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal and Housing Development in Shanghai." It proposes accelerating the redevelopment of urban villages, fully utilizing special loans for urban village redevelopment, local government special bonds, and increasing fiscal investment. Accelerate demolition and land clearance, and actively implement diversified resettlement methods such as housing vouchers. By the end of 2026, fully launch overall redevelopment projects for urban villages and complete renovation and upgrades.

headlines.title: 韩国总统李在明会见王毅
headlines.summary: 韩国总统李在明20日在首尔青瓦台会见中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅。李在明表示，两国经贸合作增长势头强劲，今年国民互访有望突破1千万人次，韩国民众对华认知不断改善，对同中国加强全面合作充满期待。当前国际形势下，韩中两国在经贸、安全等领域都相互需要，韩中加强战略合作，符合两国根本利益，对维护地区和平稳定也很重要。韩中应该成为相互依赖、互惠互补的伙伴。我期待今年11月赴深圳参加亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议，以此为重要契机，同中方一道推动韩中战略合作伙伴关系向更高水平发展。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung meets with Wang Yi
headlines.summary_en: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung met with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, at Cheong Wa Dae in Seoul on the 20th. Lee stated that bilateral trade and economic cooperation is growing strongly, with mutual visits expected to exceed 10 million this year, and South Koreans' perception of China is continuously improving, with high expectations for strengthening comprehensive cooperation with China. Under the current international situation, South Korea and China need each other in areas such as trade, economy, and security. Strengthening strategic cooperation between South Korea and China serves the fundamental interests of both countries and is important for maintaining regional peace and stability. South Korea and China should become mutually dependent, mutually beneficial, and complementary partners. He expressed hope to attend the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen in November this year, taking this as an important opportunity to work with China to elevate the South Korea-China strategic cooperative partnership to a higher level. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 中国稀土：持股5%以上股东广晟控股集团拟减持不超过1%股份
headlines.summary: 中国稀土公告，持股5%以上股东广东省广晟控股集团有限公司持有公司股份1.01亿股（占公司总股本的9.48%），计划自本次减持计划预披露公告之日起15个交易日后的三个月内，以集中竞价方式累计减持公司股份不超过1061.22万股，即不超过公司总股本的1%。减持原因为股东经营发展和资金安排需要，股份来源为行政划转取得。

headlines.title_en: China Rare Earth: Shareholder holding more than 5%, Guangsheng Holdings Group, plans to reduce stake by no more than 1%
headlines.summary_en: China Rare Earth announced that shareholder holding more than 5%, Guangdong Guangcheng Holdings Group Co., Ltd., holds 101 million shares of the company (9.48% of total share capital), and plans to reduce holdings by no more than 10.6122 million shares, i.e., no more than 1% of total share capital, through centralized bidding within three months after 15 trading days from the date of pre-disclosure of this reduction plan. The reduction is due to the shareholder's operational development and capital arrangement needs, and the shares were acquired through administrative transfer.

headlines.title: 泡泡玛特王宁：公司将在未来6个月内启动20-50亿人民币的股份回购计划；今年大概率完不成年初定的20%的业绩目标
headlines.summary: 泡泡玛特创始人王宁在中期业绩电话会上表示，未来六个月，集团将启动不低于20亿元、不高于50亿元的股份回购计划，这也是其首次在业绩会上公布股份回购计划。此外，王宁在业绩会上表示，虽然公司营收上半年完成超过20%以上的增长，但可预见的是下半年压力比上半年还会更大一些，今年大概率完不成年初既定的20%增长的目标。

headlines.title_en: Pop Mart Wang Ning: Company will launch a share buyback plan of 2-5 billion RMB within the next 6 months; this year's 20% performance target is likely not to be met
headlines.summary_en: Wang Ning, founder of Pop Mart, stated at the interim results conference call that over the next six months, the group will launch a share buyback plan of no less than RMB 2 billion and no more than RMB 5 billion, marking the first time it has announced a share buyback plan at an earnings conference. In addition, Wang Ning stated at the earnings conference that although the company's revenue grew by more than 20% in the first half of the year, it is foreseeable that pressure in the second half will be even greater than in the first half, and it is likely that the initial 20% growth target for the year will not be achieved.

headlines.title: 阿里27财年Q1自由现金流净流出446.7亿元同比扩大，系云基础设施支出增加所致
headlines.summary: 阿里巴巴公告，截至2026年6月30日止季度，经营活动产生的现金流量净额为人民币229.45亿元（33.82亿美元），相较2025年同期的人民币206.72亿元增长11%。自由现金流（一项非公认会计准则财务流动性指标）为净流出人民币446.70亿元（65.84亿美元），2025年同期为净流出人民币188.15亿元。自由现金流的下降主要归因于我们的云基础设施支出增加。于2026年6月30日，我们的现金及其他流动投资为人民币4,745.05亿元（699.33亿美元）。

headlines.title_en: Alibaba FY27 Q1 free cash flow net outflow of 44.67 billion RMB, expanding year-on-year, due to increased cloud infrastructure spending
headlines.summary_en: Alibaba announced that for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, net cash generated from operating activities was RMB 22.945 billion (USD 3.382 billion), an increase of 11% compared to RMB 20.672 billion in the same period in 2025. Free cash flow (a non-GAAP financial liquidity measure) was a net outflow of RMB 44.670 billion (USD 6.584 billion), compared to a net outflow of RMB 18.815 billion in the same period in 2025. The decrease in free cash flow is primarily attributable to increased spending on our cloud infrastructure. As of June 30, 2026, our cash and other liquid investments totaled RMB 474.505 billion (USD 69.933 billion).

headlines.title: 阿里巴巴：本季度资本性支出为人民币676.78亿元 较去年同期增长75%
headlines.summary: 阿里巴巴(09988.HK)今日公布截至2026年6月30日止季度业绩，资本性支出为人民币676.78亿元（99.75亿美元），较2025年同期的人民币386.76亿元增长75%，源于我们持续投入AI基础设施，以满足强劲且不断增长的客户需求。同比增长显著，受多项因素驱动，包括采购周期波动、预期客户持续采用AI智能体带动的CPU算力增加，以及各类芯片组件价格上涨。

headlines.title_en: Alibaba: Capital expenditure this quarter was 67.678 billion RMB, up 75% compared to the same period last year
headlines.summary_en: Alibaba (09988.HK) today announced results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Capital expenditure was RMB 67.678 billion (USD 9.975 billion), an increase of 75% compared to RMB 38.676 billion in the same period in 2025, driven by continued investment in AI infrastructure to meet strong and growing customer demand. The significant year-over-year increase is driven by multiple factors, including procurement cycle fluctuations, increased CPU computing power expected from continued customer adoption of AI agents, and rising prices of various chip components.

headlines.title_en: Alibaba: AI cloud and computing services revenue for the quarter was RMB 48.437 billion
headlines.summary_en: Alibaba (09988.HK) today announced results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, AI cloud and computing services revenue was RMB 48.437 billion, with both total revenue and external customer revenue year-over-year growth accelerating to 45%. This growth momentum is primarily driven by increased adoption of AI-related products. AI-related product revenue continued its strong momentum, reaching RMB 12.376 billion, achieving double-digit year-over-year growth for the twelfth consecutive quarter. Alibaba Cloud continues to lead the market, benefiting from increasing customer adoption of our full-stack AI capabilities, including AI agents, AI models, AI cloud infrastructure, and orchestration software for managing heterogeneous chip clusters, including self-developed chips. headlines.title: 上期所：进一步扩大合格境外投资者参与商品期货、期权交易范围
headlines.summary: 【上期所：进一步扩大合格境外投资者参与商品期货、期权交易范围】8月20日，上海期货交易所发布《关于进一步扩大合格境外投资者参与商品期货、期权交易范围的公告》。经中国证监会同意，自2026年9月10日（即当日9:00开盘）起，上海期货交易所将进一步扩大合格境外机构投资者和人民币合格境外机构投资者（统称合格境外投资者）可交易品种范围，新增开放以下商品期权：热轧卷板、不锈钢期权。

headlines.title_en: SHFE: Further expand scope for qualified foreign investors to participate in commodity futures and options trading
headlines.summary_en: [SHFE: Further Expanding Qualified Foreign Investors' Access to Commodity Futures and Options] On August 20, the Shanghai Futures Exchange issued an announcement on further expanding the scope of commodity futures and options trading for qualified foreign investors. With approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, starting from September 10, 2026 (at the 9:00 AM opening), the exchange will broaden the tradable products for Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors and RMB Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors (collectively, qualified foreign investors), adding the following commodity options: hot-rolled coil and stainless steel options.
